knowledgeAnswers.rationale: A wet saw outside or in a ventilated area keeps silica dust in the slurry and keeps occupants clear.
Damp methods or extraction clean up tile dust without spreading it.
The lesson says many tiles, especially porcelain and natural stone, contain crystalline silica, and that cutting them dry releases fine silica dust.

practicalCriteria: Given a simulated porcelain cut, the worker sets up a wet saw with adequate water and cleans up with damp methods, with no dry sweeping.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
stopWorkCriteria: Dry cutting is planned in an occupied room without extraction
